name: bosi-business-review
description: Role-based business analysis Assistants with shared analytical Skills and governed Live Dashboards for BW XMLA, SAP OData and databases.

displayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Install the roles your organization needs; share analytical methods while configuring access per instance.
description.zh_Hans: 按组织职责选装岗位助手，共享分析方法，为每个实例配置实际数据权限。

description.en_US: Discover authorized data and deliver evidence-backed analysis and project-scoped Live Dashboards for the current business question.
description.zh_Hans: 根据当前业务问题发现授权数据、分析重点并制作项目内实时看板。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Surface material changes in growth, profitability and capital usage for executive decisions.
description.zh_Hans: 面向经营负责人，聚焦增长、盈利、资金占用和需要管理层决策的重大变化。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Analyze financial performance, budget variance, liquidity risks and working capital for finance leadership.
description.zh_Hans: 面向财务负责人，分析财务绩效、预算偏差、现金风险与营运资本。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Analyze sales growth, customer and product contribution, incoming orders and sales profitability.
description.zh_Hans: 分析销售增长、客户商品贡献、订单变化与销售利润质量。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Analyze purchasing spend, supplier concentration, contract usage and supported delivery risks.
description.zh_Hans: 分析采购支出、供应商集中度、合同使用与供应履约风险。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Investigate fulfillment risks and inventory capital using authorized order, stock and delivery data.
description.zh_Hans: 连接授权的订单、库存与交付信息，发现履约风险和库存资金占用。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Analyze manufacturing execution, operation duration, scrap and authorized production-cost exceptions.
description.zh_Hans: 分析制造订单执行、工序时长、报废与有授权的生产成本偏差。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Investigate cost-center and manufacturing cost variance with reconciled accounting scope.
description.zh_Hans: 面向成本控制岗位，分析成本中心、生产订单及工作中心的实际与计划差异。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Analyze cash position, liquidity and evidence-backed incoming and outgoing cash flows.
description.zh_Hans: 面向资金岗位，分析现金头寸、流动性与有依据的未来收支。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Analyze customer receivables, aging, overdue concentration and collection trends.
description.zh_Hans: 面向应收管理岗位，分析客户欠款、逾期集中度、账龄与回款变化。

pluginDisplayName.zh_Hans: Bosi 经营分析助手套件

description.en_US: Analyze business-project and WBS budgets, actuals, completion estimates, billing and profitability.
description.zh_Hans: 分析业务项目或 WBS 的预算、实际、完工估算、开票与盈利情况。
